ext.description: Categorized Flutter & Dart CLI commands in a sidebar. Click to paste or run in your terminal.
view.flutterCommands.name: Flutter Commands
cmd.paste.title: Paste command in terminal
cmd.run.title: Run command in terminal
cmd.copy.title: Copy command
cmd.refresh.title: Refresh commands
cmd.search.title: Search commands
config.clickAction.desc: Action when clicking a command in the sidebar.
config.clickAction.paste: Paste the command into the terminal without running it (review before running).
config.clickAction.run: Run the command in the terminal immediately.
config.terminalName.desc: Name of the dedicated terminal used by the extension.
config.reuseTerminal.desc: Reuse the extension's dedicated terminal instead of creating a new one for each command.
config.customCommands.desc: Your own Flutter/Dart commands, shown in a **⭐ Custom Commands** category in the sidebar. Each entry needs a `label` and a `command`; `description` is optional.
config.customCommands.label: Short name shown in the sidebar.
config.customCommands.command: The CLI command pasted/run in the terminal.
config.customCommands.description: Optional tooltip text for the command.
